gloss: to surface; to emerge; to come to light

definitions.gloss: to surface; to rise to the surface
definitions.explanation: To come up from underwater or below the surface.

definitions.gloss: to emerge; to come to light; to become clear
definitions.explanation: For something hidden or unclear to become apparent or visible.

examples.japanese: {潜水艦|せんすいかん}が{海面|かいめん}に{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がった。
{調査|ちょうさ}で{新|あたら}しい{事実|じじつ}が{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がってきた。
examples.english: New facts have come to light through the investigation.

examples.japanese: {問題点|もんだいてん}が{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる。

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる → {浮|う}かび{上|あ}がらない (negative)
・{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる → {浮|う}かび{上|あ}がって (te-form)
・{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる → {浮|う}かび{上|あ}がった (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {浮|う}かぶ (to float) + {上|あ}がる (to rise)

USAGE:
・{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}が{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (a suspect emerges)
・{疑惑|ぎわく}が{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (suspicions arise)
・{真相|しんそう}が{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (the truth comes to light)
・{課題|かだい}が{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (issues emerge)

NUANCE:
Often used in news and investigation contexts when previously hidden information becomes known.
